gigs.title: I will build a custom AI automation pipeline using Claude or ChatGPT
gigs.description:
I build custom AI automation pipelines that dispatch jobs to Claude and ChatGPT automatically — without API costs.

You give me a spec or a problem. I deliver a working automation system.

What I've built:
• A sovereign AI orchestration system (216,000+ lines) that controls Claude and ChatGPT through browser automation — zero per-request cost
• Spec-driven pipelines that automatically chunk, dispatch, verify, and deliver code
• Self-healing systems that detect and fix their own failures
• Runs for $20/month flat — no API bills

What I can build for you:
• Custom automation that dispatches tasks to AI providers automatically
• Spec-to-code pipelines — give me a specification, get working code back
• AI-powered workflows for your existing system
• Browser automation agents

I work fast. I work bottom-up. Nothing silently fails.

faq.a: No. My approach uses browser automation — no API costs. You need a Claude.ai or ChatGPT account (free or paid).

faq.q: What do you need from me?
faq.a: A clear description of what you want automated. The clearer the spec, the faster I deliver.
Node.js primarily, but I can adapt. The orchestration layer is language-agnostic.

faq.q: Can you work with my existing system?
faq.a: Yes. I build integrations, not just standalone tools.
